'''Blackthorn Ridge'''{{co|43|80|Northern Barrens}} is a thorny valley located just north of the [[Quilboar]] capital of [[Razorfen Kraul]], populated primarily by [[Razormane tribe|Razormane]] [[Quilboar]]. The [[orc]] [[shaman]] [[Brine]] dwells on the ridge that gives this area it's name. Just below her camp, lies a pool whose water is of notable quality and purity.
